Text: Almighty and everlasting God, shower blessings on those seeking You in prayer. Out of Your inexhaustible love, You give to them beyond their merits and desires. [t] Pour Your mercy upon us [*] that our consciences may be freed from worry. More than we ask for or imagine, You give to us
Changes: 2023-09-02 - Paul Prins: Fixed casing on divine pronouns.
